Which plan is right for me? Our plans are built to scale with your needs. They include all the basic features and become increasingly more powerful depending on which plan you choose. Here's how they break down: Free (for individuals): This plan is for teams with less than 3 people. It includes all the basic features, but has limited capabilities, including email and data enrichment. Plus (for single teams): This plan has an unlimited amount of seats. It has enhanced data enrichment, email capabilities such as sending and sharing and enhanced contact analysis. Pro (for scaling businesses): This plan is for businesses who need a single source of truth across their entire organization. It includes complete email sharing and sending capabilities, advanced data enrichment, advanced access permissions and extensive report building. Enterprise (for large organizations): This plan includes everything from our Pro plan plus advanced admin tools, permission access and SAML support. It is built for large organizations with strategic relationships spanning multiple business units. Does Attio have a free trial? Yes! Attio has a 14-day trial of our Pro plan which you can use to explore whether Attio is right for you. Is Attio free to use? Attio has plans for teams of all sizes, including a free option for very small teams or light projects. Our paid plans are incredibly powerful and are the best way to get the most out of Attio. How do credits work? Attio has two types of credits that are shared across our AI and workflows features. Workspace credits: for anyone in the workspace to use on all AI features, including Ask Attio, and workflows Seat credits: for each seat to use personally on Ask Attio Every plan includes credits for you to get started, and you can always add more workspace credits as needed. For more details on how credits work, check out our guide . Do you offer discounts? Our Plus and Pro plans come with a 20% discount with annual billing. What are my payment options? All payments can be made via credit card. For our Pro and Enterprise plans, we can issue invoices and will accept PO, ACH, check or wire. Please contact our sales team for more information. Do you offer invoice billing? We can issue invoices for our users of our Pro and Enterprise plans. Do I need to connect my email? Connecting your email and calendar is not required. However, we recommend you sync your email and calendar with Attio. When you sync your email and calendar, Attio instantly builds a real-time, global database of all your contacts. The more contacts you have in the database, the better our product becomes for you. Can I import data from other tools? Yes! You can easily import data into Attio from other applications through CSV files. Do you have a startup program? Yes! We offer up to 80% off for eligible startups and you can apply here . For more information on the program feel free to reach out to the team at [email protected] . Do you have monthly and annual billing options? Our plans are billed either annually or monthly. If you choose to pay annually for our Plus and Pro plans, you'll receive a 20% discount. Does Attio have an API? Yes. Attio has a custom API that allows you to integrate with other tools in your stack.
